entries.0913d556985db47a: Chukyo Co., Ltd. manufactures office chairs and other products, which the company sells.
entries.12dba04fd8fab600: Manufacturers of industrial vehicles and industrial robots
entries.18191e2e4d1f819c: This is the main business, manufacturing and selling cast iron and aluminum products. It handles automotive parts, industrial vehicle parts and industrial robot parts, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥37,573 million. Part of manufacturing is handled by consolidated subsidiaries and equity-method affiliates.
entries.2e4ce627f79f88d4: A manufacturer that manufactures and sells cast iron and aluminum automotive parts and industrial machinery parts, and metal furniture such as office chairs.
entries.6712d0526bde81b1: In addition to manufacturing and selling its own products, the company entrusts part of manufacturing to Takeyama Chuzo Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) and Suzhou Chuo Malleable Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary).
entries.67131baac8f190e7: This business sells office furniture, including various chairs for offices and facilities. Manufacturing is carried out by Chukyo Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, which supplies the company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,146 million.
entries.a6ddabf8bb720b89: In addition to manufacturing and selling its own products, the company entrusts part of manufacturing to Toki Malleable Iron Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary) and Suzhou Ishikawa Seitetsu Co., Ltd. (equity-method affiliate), and entrusts part of the manufacturing process to three affiliated companies: Chuo Kensaku Kogyo Co., Ltd., Mizuho Kinzoku Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Nagoya Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. Its products are supplied to Toyota Motor Corporation and others.
